### Those Final Moments
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-june-21-2016.html
Passage: Genesis 49:33
Points:
- Jacob concluded his earthly life by giving prophetic blessings and specific burial instructions to all his sons.
- He met death with peaceful composure, drawing his feet up into the bed and breathing his last breath.
- Being gathered to his people illustrates that believers transition immediately into the presence of God and fellow saints.
- Grieving families can find comfort knowing that departure from this physical body leads directly to eternity with the Lord.
- The ultimate purpose and full significance of a person's life are finally translated and realized after death.
